ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are four circles in the picture, labeled A, B, C, and D respectively. C corresponds to the third circle, and the main constituent factors inside the circle include “internal and external technological conditions,” “modern communication network,” “government encouragement policies,” and “other,” among which technological conditions and modern communication network are key factors. Then reason: These formation factors reflect obvious high-technology, information-network, and policy-support orientations, and do not belong to raw-material-oriented or tourism-resource-oriented industries. Therefore, the advantageous industry of region C should be judged as the electronic information industry.

甲、乙、丙、丁表示我国四个地区优势产业形成要素构成图。

<image1>

根据图示，丙地区的优势产业是什么？
